articles.title: Protester mot datacenter runtom i Europa
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Protester mot datacenter runtom i Europa
articles.body_text: Demonstration mot ett datacenter utanför danska Køge på lördagen. Protester mot datacenter runtom i Europa En bred samling aktivistgrupper och andra organisationer demonstrerar mot datacenter runtom i Europa under lördagen. Demonstrationerna arrangeras under den gemensamma banderollen ”Stop dirty data centers”. I Finland hålls protester på flera platser. I Helsingfors gick ett demonstrationståg förbi Googles kontor, med uppemot 1 500 deltagande, rapporterar Yle . Google håller på att upprätta flera stora datacenter i Finland, men misstankar om olovlig avverkning av skog har satt ett par av storbyggena på is. I Danmark samlades samtidigt demonstranter utanför Microsofts datacenter utanför Køge på Själland, rapporterar Politiken . Redan i fredags drog protesterna i gång. Då frihetsberövades uppemot 200 demonstranter i Amsterdam. Enligt arrangören hålls demonstrationer i en rad europeiska länder, bland annat Storbritannien, Spanien och Frankrike.

articles.title: AI har inte snott jobben – än så länge
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: AI har inte snott jobben – än så länge
articles.body_text: AI kan komma att ersätta många kontorsjobb. En uppsjö av bedömare varnar för att AI kommer att konkurrera ut hela yrkesgrupper. Men än så länge tycks den svenska arbetsmarknaden ha överlevt tekniken – och vissa jobb står stadigt i stormen. Om man är väldigt rädd för osäkerhet så finns en del säkra kort, säger Oskar Nordström Skans, professor i nationalekonomi vid Uppsala universitet. En AI-oro sprider sig i Sverige. Bedömare och rapporter varnar för olika yrken som tekniken kommer att ta över. Men frågan är när och om det skiftet kommer att märkas i statistiken. Hittills i Sverige ser vi inte tecken på att AI-användningen skulle vara förknippad med någon större påverkan på sysselsättningen eller på arbetslösheten överlag, säger Magnus Lodefalk, docent i nationalekonomi vid Örebro universitet. Arbetsförmedlingen och Statistiska centralbyrån (SCB), som ansvarar för arbetsmarknadssiffrorna, har inga data som visar hur AI påverkat de svenska jobben. Flera statistiker och akademiker blickar i stället mot den färska rapporten ”Strukturomvandlingen och AI”, som Uppsala universitet och Tillväxtanalys nyligen publicerat. ”Några tydliga tecken på en omfattande AI-driven strukturomvandling går ännu inte att observera i den samlade ekonomin”, skriver författarna . Där vi ser vissa förändringar och som skulle kunna bero på AI så handlar det framför allt om de som är nyutexaminerade från universitetet, säger Oskar Nordström Skans, en av rapportens författare. Särskilt gäller det utbildningsprogram som leder till yrken där AI används flitigt, exempelvis programmering.

articles.title: Litet lyft för nedtryckt fransk vinproduktion
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Litet lyft för nedtryckt fransk vinproduktion
articles.body_text: Tjuvarna riktade in sig på krogens finaste vinflaskor. Arkivbild. Litet lyft för nedtryckt fransk vinproduktion Frankrike höjer sin ovanligt dystra prognos för vinproduktion. Sena sommarregn verkar ha motverkat de värsta effekterna av torkan tidigare under säsongen. Helårsprognosen för fransk vinproduktion i år höjs till 36,7 miljoner liter, beräknat utifrån de första skörderapporterna. Det är 5 procent högre än prognosen från oktober och 3 procent högre än fjolårets skörd. Vändningen jämfört med tidigare beräkningar märks tydligast i stora vinregioner som Languedoc-Roussillon och Charentes. Även om den nya prognosen håller är vinproduktionen lägre än vanligt i Frankrike, ungefär 10 procent under snittproduktionen fem år bakåt i tiden. En av de regioner som drabbats värst av torkan är Champagne. Där ser hälften av produktionen av de mousserande vinerna i år ut att hamna på ungefär hälften av 2025 års nivåer.

articles.title: Huang kallas till förhör efter spionuppgifter
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Huang kallas till förhör efter spionuppgifter
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang. Bild från hans senaste Stockholmsbesök, i mitten av oktober. Huang kallas till förhör efter spionuppgifter Nvidias vd kallas till utfrågningar i USA:s kongress, efter medieuppgifter om att han haft en relation med en befarad kinesisk spion. Bland andra Financial Times och The New York Times har, med hänvisning till källor, skrivit om att Nvidia-chefen Jensen Huang umgåtts med en kvinna som lett en av it-bjässens kunder. Efter artiklarna har tre utskott i USA:s representanthus begärt att Huang ska inställa sig den 18 november. Ämnet för utfrågningen beskrivs i kallelsen som ”Nvidias säkerhetsrutiner mot utländskt spionage och ert samröre med vad som rapporteras vara en kinesisk underrättelseperson”. USA har hårda kontroller visavi Kina för avancerad teknik, och uppges nu befara att kvinnan ingår i försök att påverka reglerna. Nvidia har tidigare avvisat misstankarna , och förklarat att det är fullt naturligt att Huang umgås med kunder.

articles.title: Barn blev appberoende – förlikas med techjätte
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Barn blev appberoende – förlikas med techjätte
articles.body_text: Två tonåringar anklagar Snap för att medvetet ha gjort dem beroende. Arkivbild. Barn blev appberoende – förlikas med techjätte Två tonåringar som anklagat Snapchat för att medvetet ha gjort dem beroende av appen har nått en förlikning med ägaren. Målet hade valts ut av en domstol i Kalifornien bland tusentals liknande fall. ”Vårt yttersta mål är att sociala medier-företagen ska stå till svars för hur deras agerande har påverkat miljontals barn i landet”, säger advokaten John Morgan, som företräder ungdomarna, i ett uttalande. Tonåringarna från Illinois och Mississippi började använda Youtube vid tre års ålder och andra appar när de var nio, enligt Reuters . De anklagar företagen för att ha skapat beroendeframkallande funktioner. Nu har de gjort upp med den börsnoterade techjätten Snap, efter att tidigare ha ingått förlikningar med Meta, Tiktok och Youtube. Snaps vd Evan Spiegel skulle vittna i domstolen i veckan, men i och med förlikningen undvek man vad som hade varit företagets första rättegång om Snapchats påverkan på unga. Samtidigt tillbakavisar Snap anklagelserna och hävdar att företaget vidtagit åtgärder för att göra apparna till ”trygga platser” där unga kan uttrycka sig. Fallet hade valts ut av Kaliforniens högsta domstol bland tusentals liknande fall. Meta och Youtube förlorade ett första sådant mål i delstaten i mars. En jury utdömde då 6 miljoner dollar i skadestånd till en ung kvinna. Nästa liknande fall kommer att inledas i mars, enligt Reuters .

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

Det och mycket annat frågade SVT Sports programledare André Pops honom.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
articles.summary: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospecting of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
articles.body_text: The US has announced a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran's nuclear programme. The State Department's Rewards for Justice is also offering to potentially relocate the person who provides such details. President Donald Trump claimed last year that Iran's nuclear facilities had been "completely and totally obliterated " following a bombing campaign by the US and Israel. Iran insists its nuclear programme is peaceful and that it has no intention of developing a nuclear weapon. Meanwhile, the US military says it is setting up a task force to enhance Washington's efforts to restrict Iran's movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders. The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said Task Force Iron Gate would operate from Tampa, Florida, and would work with other US government agencies. As well as the movement of weapons, it will also focus on dual-use and illegal revenue streams. Centcom estimates that its naval blockade of Iran's ports has prevented the country from exporting more than $25bn in crude oil. A US State Department statement about its multi-million dollar reward said it was offering the money for information about the Iranian programme, including "facilities, equipment and associated personnel". It said Iran's "lack of compliance with the IAEA [the International Atomic Energy Agency] on safeguards obligations has led to the agency's loss of 'continuity of knowledge' regarding Iran's production and inventory of key components like [nuclear] centrifuges". Centrifuges are needed to produce enriched uranium, which can be used to make reactor fuel for civilian use but also for nuclear weapons if enriched to around 90% purity or higher. There had been mounting speculation that the US might resume significant strikes in Iran after the midterm elections, though Trump told reporters, prior to the polls, that he was in "no rush" to do so.

articles.title: Gaza wedding festival sees 250 couples married at the same time
articles.summary: A mass wedding for Palestinian brides and grooms has taken place in the rubble-strewn streets of Gaza.
articles.body_text: Amid the ruins of destroyed buildings and displaced people's tents, Gazans gathered to celebrate a mass wedding for Palestinian brides and grooms. The ceremony, organised by the UAE's humanitarian mission Operation Gallant Knight 3, brought together brides and grooms from across Gaza for a celebration of what organisers described as love and new beginnings in the besieged enclave. A ceasefire came into force in Gaza in October last year, but Israeli air strikes have continued almost every day. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Israel responded by launching a military campaign against Hamas in Gaza, during which more than 74,640 people have been killed, according to the territory's health ministry. Despite having the highest voter turnout in nearly three decades, Israel's elections have had no clear winner. What does this mean for the country, asks the BBC's Yolande Knell. Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner. The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast. Israel faces what many view as one of the most pivotal elections in the country's history. Security and democracy emerge as central issues in Israel's highly anticipated general election, as Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports. Dozens of people had been inside the church for a funeral when the shooting began, local media report. Israeli settlers were seen attacking Palestinian farmers and setting fire to olive trees in the West Bank.

articles.title: Krakow shooting: What we know about gun attack in Poland
articles.summary: At least six people were killed by a gunman in military fatigues who opened fire in Poland's second largest city.
articles.body_text: At least six people have been killed and several others injured after a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. Here's everything we know so far. The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city. Police said a man drove into the square before beginning to fire "at random people from his car". Footage from the scene shows scenes of panic as people fled, with the sound of gunfire clearly heard. A passing tram was shot at during the apparently random attack, shattering windows but no passengers were injured. Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the attacker, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said. The gunman was shot but is alive and has been arrested. Distressing footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment a police officer confronts the suspect on the ground before firing his weapon several times. The officer then falls to the ground, apparently having been injured himself. Shop windows in the square have signs of damage, seemingly from bullets, with glass shards scattered along the floor. City officials have urged people who live in the city and tourists to stay away from the area while an investigation continues. The suspect's car, found at the intersection of Dietla and Stradomska streets, is being checked for possible explosive devices, police say. Residents of nearby buildings are being evacuated while the operation is under way.

articles.title: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.
articles.body_text: Media linked to the Houthi movement in Yemen say that at least 25 people, including women and children, have been killed in airstrikes by Saudi Arabia. There has been no comment from the Saudi-led coalition backing the internationally recognised government in Yemen. Live video footage on Al Masirah - a television station run by the Houthis - has shown rescuers pulling bodies out of the rubble of several buildings in al-Shariyah, a town to the east of the capital, Sanaa. The bodies of young children can be seen among those dug out from the ruins. The television station has also shown a number of injured people being carried on stretchers to hospital. Saba news agency, which is also run by the Houthis, said the attack was carried out by Saudi Arabia. The Saudis have led a coalition that has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade in support of Yemen's internationally recognised government. The war in Yemen had been dormant for several years but reignited as a result of the Iran war. A truce began to fall apart when Saudi Arabia struck the airport in Sanaa - which is controlled by the Houthis - to prevent an Iranian plan landing there. The Tehran-backed Houthis subsequently targeted Abha airport in Saudi Arabia, then began hitting Saudi ships that have been using the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz. Major fighting has since resumed in Yemen between the Houthis and forces fighting for the Saudi-backed government of Yemen. On Friday, an attack on a market in Taiz province, which has been the focus of much of the recent fighting, is reported to have killed 30 people.

articles.title: Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani says 'cyber-criminals' shared his personal data on dark web
articles.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.
articles.body_text: Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani says he has been targeted by "cyber-criminals" who published his personal data online because of his country's support for Ukraine. "For days now, cyber-criminals have been publishing my personal data on the dark web and seeking further information, effectively exposing me to new threats and intimidation," Tajani wrote on X. He did not specify the nature of the threats, but said the hackers were also targeting his family. The dark web is a hidden part of the internet that is not indexed by common search engines and can only be accessed with specialist software. "Our position on Ukraine is the political reason I have been targeted," Tajani said. "Defending the freedom of a sovereign state, taking a clear stand in support of a nation's democracy and independence, is dangerous in the eyes of these criminal entities." Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni blamed the incident on pro-Russian hackers and offered Tajani her "full solidarity". "The sale of confidential information about institutional representatives is a cause of serious concern and must be tackled with the utmost determination," she said in a statement. Moscow has not publicly responded to the allegations. Meloni also expressed concern about "circulation of false images" which she said were shared by members of Italy's opposition. She did not give details about the content of the images. The Italian government has provided humanitarian and military support to Ukraine in its war against Russia. Tajani, who is also the deputy prime minister, said the government was taking the threats seriously.

articles.title: New Zealand election: No clear winner after tight general election
articles.summary: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.
articles.body_text: There was no clear winner following New Zealand's election on Saturday, as the leaders of its two major parties preparing for negotiations to form a coalition government. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's centre-right National Party won 42 seats but was 19 short of the simple majority needed to form a government, despite being the largest party, preliminary results show. Combined with their coalition partners ACT and New Zealand First, they would have a slim lead over the left-leaning bloc if a deal could be reached. But opposition leader Chris Hipkins, whose Labour Party won 36 seats, showed no signs of conceding, saying the "shape of the next government" will remain uncertain "for a while". The tight result followed a campaign shaped by the cost of living and unemployment. Projections show the National Party on 42 seats and Labour on 36. The Greens are on 16, with ACT on 13, New Zealand First on 12, the Opportunity Party on 7 and Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests, on 5. The electoral commission was not due to announced the official result until 27 November. Luxon congratulated Hipkins on a "very hard-fought race" before addressing party colleagues, saying "whatever the final count, we are incredibly proud of each and everyone for you". He said he would run a caretaker government until the final results were confirmed later in the month, adding: "With those final results there can then be meaningful negotiations." Elsewhere, Labour leader Kipkins said "the people have spoken", adding: "It may take a bit longer to work out what they've said." Hipkins said the results made clear the "next parliament is going to require all of us to compromise, to work together and to find a common ground". More than 99% of votes have been counted in New Zealand, with National and Labour neck-and-neck in terms of vote share.

articles.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, says Barnier
articles.summary: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".
articles.body_text: The prime minister has said rejoining the bloc's internal market was among options he could pursue as part of a reshaping of ties since the UK's exit from the EU nearly six years ago. But Michel Barnier told the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg that EU members would insist on the UK readopting certain conditions, such as the free movement of people, to gain access. He said there was not a "single market à la carte" menu from which the UK could pick and choose what elements it wanted to adopt. Barnier - who led the EU delegation during Brexit talks between 2016 and 2021, and had a three-month spell as French prime minister in 2024 - said the "door is open" within Europe to the UK rejoining as an EU member. But he insisted that any move to rejoin the single market - which allows for goods to be freely traded without border controls - would require the UK to follow the same terms as other members. He added that this included compliance with regulations designed to promote the circulation of goods, services, capital and people, referred to collectively within EU institutions as the "four freedoms". "There will be no possibility to have one freedom and not the other. The four freedoms are clearly the four conditions to be inside a single market." Since becoming prime minister in July, Burnham has suggested he could commit Labour to pursuing a much closer future relationship with Europe, including asking to rejoin the organisation as a full member, though he has ruled out major changes before the next election. His predecessors have struck a series of deals with the EU on different aspects of how the UK and EU interact post-Brexit. Both sides are hoping to use a meeting in Brussels in 10 days' time to unveil deals on food standards, youth visas and re-linking British industry to the EU's carbon trading regime . Of the four freedoms, the free movement of people - which allows EU citizens to live and work elsewhere in the bloc without a visa - was a key issue during the 2016 Brexit referendum. Burnham's immediate predecessor, Sir Keir Starmer, ruled out re-establishing it for the UK in Labour's 2024 election manifesto and any move to advocate it again would prove a key dividing line with the Conservatives and Reform UK at a future poll.

articles.title: Ukraine's power network suffers further damage after fresh Russian strikes
articles.summary: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
articles.body_text: Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies. Zelensky said 12 Ukrainian regions came under attack with the capital Kyiv hit hardest. Nine people are reported to have been hurt across the country, including one child, in the wave of attacks that consisted of more than 30 ballistic missiles and over 170 drones. The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week. Zelensky wrote on Telegram that Moscow was preparing for the talks by launching attacks on Ukraine's "critical infrastructure". Temperatures are dropping in Ukraine, and parts of the country have had the first winter snow. "The situation in the capital is difficult, with disruptions to electricity, water, and heating supplies. Residential buildings, the North Bridge, and a kindergarten have been damaged," Zelensky said. "In the Kyiv region, there were strikes on substations that connect the Rivne and Khmelnytsky nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine." In his latest update, Kyiv's Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the city's water supply system is back to operating normally. He also said around 60% of the city's apartment buildings were connected to the heating system. The energy minister, Denys Shmyhal, said there were power cuts in five regions but did not say how many homes were affected. Zelensky added that beyond Kyiv, substations were damaged in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv and Dnipro regions. The latest attacks come after US First Lady Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House on Thursday.

articles.title: Pope Leo in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
articles.summary: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
articles.body_text: Pope Leo XIV has told reporters travelling with him to Latin America he is "in pretty good health", in his first comments on his condition since having surgery for lung cancer. The Pope has arrived in Uruguay, the first stop of a 12-day tour which he is undertaking only three weeks after his operation. The pontiff, 71, also said he was "very happy" to be able to make the trip which was thrown into doubt last month when doctors discovered a tumour during a routine scan. The tour will cover Argentina and a much anticipated return to Peru , which the Vatican described as a "homecoming" as the Pope was based there for many years as a missionary, then a bishop. "I must confess that, from the very first day, I never had any doubts; I was convinced that this journey had to go forward," the Pope told journalists on his plane to Uruguay. "Thanks to the marvellous medical staff... I believe I am in quite good health," Pope Leo confirmed. Last month's operation to remove a tumour was successful and his doctors say the cancer has not spread. On Friday, he arrived in Monetevideo to a seafront lined with crowds shouting his name as his Popemobile passed. In his first speech of the trip, the Pope said universal healthcare should be "accessible to everyone". He told the crowd in Plaza Independencia the care he received made him think of the "many men and women who lack the means to obtain a timely diagnosis" or receive treatment. He capped his day with a prayer at the Montevideo Cathedral. Pope Leo will cover more than 20,000 miles on his sixth international tour.

articles.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña impeached and under house arrest
articles.summary: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.
articles.body_text: Prosecutors in Paraguay have charged former president Santiago Peña over his alleged role in a banking scandal that led to his impeachment. He has been accused of breach of trust and administration for personal gain. Peña, who denies any wrongdoing, was forced from office after a bank collapse triggered a crisis that left more than half of the country's population without access to their accounts. He was arrested on Friday minutes after lawmakers, including from his own party, unanimously voted to remove him from office following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which has links to his private business interests. He had offered to step down but rather than accept his resignation, senators impeached Peña and charged him with misconduct, meaning he has been stripped of the immunity usually granted to ex-presidents. Peña, who until last year held shares in the company that owned the bank, has denied any wrongdoing. The impeachment charges that led to Peña's removal alleged he had conflicts of interest, manipulated regulatory oversight, diverted pension funds, and participated in an institutional cover-up involving the central bank. Peña's deputy, Pedro Alliana, has been sworn in as the new interim president and promised not to "abandon" the millions of people affected by the scandal. "Compatriots who are now going through a difficult time as a result of the financial collapse will be fully compensated," said Alliana, who will serve as president until 2028. The demise of the digital bank left more than half of Paraguay's population without access to their savings after it was seized by Paraguay's central bank. Long lines of people trying to withdraw money from Ueno branches snaked down the streets of the capital Asuncion on Tuesday and Wednesday. An estimated three million depositors remain unable to access their savings and pensions, prompting public outrage particularly in the capital, Asunción.

articles.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
articles.summary: The US president's promotion of Miller, a loyal partisan firebrand to be his new chief of staff sets up likely clashes with Congress.
articles.body_text: In the aftermath of the Republican Party's sweeping defeat in Tuesday's midterm elections, Donald Trump said he would be willing to work with the newly ascendent Democrats in Congress. On Friday, however, he elevated Stephen Miller, his bare-knuckled political operative and longtime adviser, to replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff. Far from an olive branch to Congress, Miller's promotion could be a sign that the president is girding for political battle by installing a partisan firebrand in the top White House job. "The mission now is more clear than ever: Fight with all of our soul to support our president and defend this magnificent republic," Miller posted on X, adding that he was "honored beyond words" to be Trump's pick for the job. One of the most powerful positions in Washington, the chief of staff is gatekeeper to the president, agenda-setter in the White House and chief negotiator with Congress and other outside political interests. "Stephen Miller's been with me since the beginning," Trump said in comments to reporters after announcing the move on his Truth Social website. "He gets it." Miller is best known for being the driving force behind the Trump administration's aggressive immigration enforcement policies, which has included ramping up funding for enforcement operations across the US. He made headlines when he called Alex Pretti, who was shot and killed by federal immigration officials during a massive deportation operation in Minneapolis, a "domestic terrorist" and an "assassin". He would later walk back those words, saying federal agents "may not have been following" proper protocol. He has also reportedly played a leading role in the US military operations in Venezuela and against suspected drug trafficking operations in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific, which critics have condemned as extra-judicial killings. Miller joined Trump's political operation early in his 2016 presidential bid as a strategist and incendiary warm-up speaker at his raucous campaign rallies. He was one of the few senior White House staffers to persevere through the entirety of his first term. He stayed loyal to Trump during his political exile following attempts to overturn his ballot-box defeat in 2020 failed. He then returned in the influential role of deputy chief of staff for policy in Trump's second term. Wiles, who co-managed the president's successful 2024 re-election campaign, developed a reputation as a cool professional who avoided the White House staffing upheavals, dramatic policy reversals and personality clashes that typified Trump's first presidential term.

articles.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
articles.summary: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.
articles.body_text: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, has been placed under house detention at his assisted living facility in Florida after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material. Markle, 82, was arrested in Florida on a federal complaint alleging he held images that show child sex abuse, the US Department of Justice (DoJ) said. He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, the DoJ said. Markle has previously denied allegations of possessing images of child sex abuse, calling them "sick lies". In a 30-minute court hearing on Friday he was also ordered to submit to electronic monitoring, but no plea was taken. At the court hearing, the charges were laid out against him by federal prosecutor Courtenay Derry, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News. He was brought into court in a wheelchair, escorted by two US Marshals. Markle was wearing black trousers and a black t-shirt. No plea was taken during the hearing, and an arraignment date in California will be determined in due course, a joint statement from the DoJ and the US Attorney's Office Central California said. The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have not commented on Markle's arrest. Markle was arrested after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in LA registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said. Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material. FBI director Kash Patel said authorities "moved quickly" when arresting Markle. "Mr Markle allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions," Patel said.

articles.title: MEF confirma cambios en los feriados de 2027: estos son los días que tendrán nuevas fechas en Perú
articles.summary: MEF confirma cambios en los feriados de 2027: estos son los días que tendrán nuevas fechas en Perú
articles.body_text: El calendario de feriados en Perú podría experimentar modificaciones a partir de 2027, luego de que el ministro de Economía y Finanzas, Elmer Cuba, ratificara la intención del Gobierno de trasladar al lunes los días festivos que coincidan con martes, miércoles, jueves o viernes. La iniciativa busca reducir las interrupciones en las actividades laborales durante la semana y mejorar la productividad, además de facilitar la planificación de las empresas y los servicios turísticos. Sin embargo, todavía no cuenta con un mecanismo legal que permita su aplicación, por lo que las nuevas fechas aún no están oficialmente establecidas. Conoce qué feriados serían trasladados si se concreta esta propuesta y qué aspectos siguen pendientes de definición. Si se concreta la iniciativa del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), seis feriados nacionales tendrían nuevas fechas durante 2027. Esta sería la distribución prevista según el criterio anunciado: Cabe señalar que en diciembre surge una duda sobre la aplicación de esta medida, ya que el feriado de la Inmaculada Concepción, que corresponde al 8 de diciembre, y el de la Batalla de Ayacucho, celebrado el 9 de diciembre, serían trasladados al lunes 6. Esto provocaría que ambos descansos coincidan en una misma fecha, por lo que todavía no está claro cómo se resolvería esta situación Elmer Cuba explicó que el Ejecutivo busca evitar que los descansos interrumpan las actividades económicas a mitad de semana. Durante una entrevista con RPP, reiteró que los feriados comprendidos entre martes y viernes serían trasladados al primer día de la semana. “Se ha decidido mover los feriados a los lunes. Cualquier feriado que caiga de martes a viernes se pasa al lunes para que no hagan tanto daño como un feriado a media semana”, manifestó. Aunque el ministro volvió a ratificar la iniciativa, esta todavía no tiene una norma que permita su ejecución ni un proyecto presentado ante el Congreso. articles.summary: La Fiscalía de Paraguay solicitó este sábado que se ordene la prisión preventiva contra el expresidente Santiago Peña, al que imputó formalmente por presunta lesión de confianza y administración en provecho propio durante su comparecencia dentro de la investigación por el cierre de Ueno bank, una entidad a la que ha sido vinculado el exmandatario y cuyo caso provocó su destitución.
articles.body_text: La Fiscalía de Paraguay solicitó este sábado que se ordene la prisión preventiva contra el expresidente Santiago Peña, al que imputó formalmente por presunta lesión de confianza y administración en provecho propio durante su comparecencia dentro de la investigación por el cierre de Ueno bank, una entidad a la que ha sido vinculado el exmandatario y cuyo caso provocó su destitución. Peña fue detenido el viernes poco después de haber sido hallado culpable en un juicio político por “mal desempeño de funciones” tras la disolución por problemas de insolvencia de Ueno, un banco con 2,94 millones de clientes, entre ellos importantes instituciones estatales cuyos fondos quedaron congelados. Tras la solicitud del Ministerio Público, un juez deberá determinar, en una audiencia de imposición de medidas, si acepta el pedido de los fiscales. Según el acta de imputación, el exmandatario está acusado por presunta lesión de confianza como instigador y por administración en provecho propio en calidad de autor. El documento indica que el expresidente “habría intervenido en circunstancias relacionadas con la colocación, renovación y permanencia de importantes sumas de dinero provenientes de entidades públicas y previsionales” en Ueno bank, una entidad con cuyo grupo empresarial Peña “habría mantenido una relación económica y corporativa previa”. Peña era accionista de Ueno Holding, un conglomerado del Grupo Vásquez que poseía, entre otras empresas, a Ueno bank. En marzo de 2025 vendió esa participación, detalló la acusación de los diputados que promovieron el juicio político en su contra. Ueno bank, añade el documento de la Fiscalía, habría recibido esos recursos públicos “mientras desarrollaba operaciones crediticias con sociedades presuntamente vinculadas a su grupo económico”, en las que “fueron identificadas observaciones e irregularidades por parte de los órganos de supervisión del Banco Central”. El Ministerio Público también imputó y pidió la prisión preventiva contra el expresidente del Banco Central de Paraguay (BCP) Carlos Carvallo, por presunta lesión de confianza, producción inmediata de documentos públicos de contenido falso y administración en provecho propio, en calidad de autor. Carvallo se presentó en la noche del viernes ante las autoridades y fue arrestado. El exfuncionario presidió la Financiera Ueno, de la que nació Ueno bank, antes de asumir en 2023 la jefatura de la entidad emisora, cuyo directorio autorizó “83 días después” de su designación la creación de la finiquitada entidad bancaria, explicaron los diputados en su acusación. Durante la administración de Peña, el Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS), una de las principales cajas pensionales del país, invirtió unos 355 millones de dólares en Ueno, que también administraba las cuentas de unos 32.000 jubilados. Por este caso, la Fiscalía también ha imputado a 27 personas, entre ellas Miguel Vásquez, uno de los fundadores de Ueno bank, quien este viernes fue trasladado junto a otros cinco directivos a cárceles para procesados.

articles.title: ¿Noviembre tiene feriados? Revisa los días libres de labores este 2026 en el Perú
articles.summary: Tras el feriado del primero de noviembre, te invitamos a conocer si hay otros feriados o días no laborables en el mes de noviembre. Conócelo todos en la siguiente nota.
articles.body_text: Los días libres son una oportunidad para compartir tiempo en familia, organizar actividades personales o realizar pequeños viajes sin las obligaciones habituales del trabajo. En noviembre de 2026, el calendario peruano contempla fechas de descanso que deben distinguirse entre feriados nacionales y días no laborables establecidos de manera extraordinaria. Estas últimas disposiciones están vinculadas con la visita del papa León XIV al Perú y comprenden jornadas y horarios específicos en Lima, Callao y otras regiones del país. Además, no todos los trabajadores tendrán las mismas condiciones para acceder a estos descansos, pues algunas medidas requieren compensar posteriormente las horas que se dejen de trabajar. Conoce qué fechas están previstas para noviembre, en qué lugares se aplicarán y cuáles son las diferencias que debes tener en cuenta antes de organizar tus actividades. El calendario de noviembre tiene un feriado nacional, el pasado 1 de noviembre, día de todos los santos, sin embargo; también cuenta con días NO laborables según lo indica la ley. Estas últimas fueron oficializadas mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 020-2026-TR, publicado en el diario oficial El Peruano. El calendario contempla las siguientes fechas: La compensación dependerá del sector laboral. En las entidades públicas, las horas pendientes deberán recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores al descanso o cuando lo determine el titular de cada institución, de acuerdo con las necesidades del servicio. En las empresas privadas, empleadores y trabajadores podrán acordar cómo reponer el tiempo no trabajado. Si no consiguen llegar a un consenso, el empleador establecerá las condiciones para realizar la compensación correspondiente. Aunque ambas fechas permiten interrumpir las actividades habituales, tienen condiciones distintas. El feriado constituye un descanso obligatorio reconocido por ley y no requiere recuperar las horas que correspondían a esa jornada. En cambio, los días no laborables suelen estar dirigidos principalmente al sector público y contemplan la recuperación posterior del tiempo pendiente. Para los trabajadores privados, su aplicación depende del acuerdo entre empleadores y trabajadores. Según la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), si un empleado trabaja en un día feriado debido a necesidades de la empresa o rotación de turnos, y no recibe un día libre en sustitución, debe recibir una compensación económica equivalente a tres veces su salario habitual por esa jornada laboral. Esto se debe a tres conceptos: No cumplir con el pago adicional o negar la compensación de descanso constituye una infracción muy grave en materia laboral. Las sanciones económicas varían según el tipo de empresa, y pueden ir desde poco más de 1.000 soles hasta superar los 24.000.

Peña fue detenido el viernes poco después de haber sido hallado culpable en un juicio político por “mal desempeño de funciones” tras la disolución por problemas de insolvencia de Ueno, un banco con 2,94 millones de clientes, entre ellos importantes instituciones estatales cuyos fondos quedaron congelados. Tras la solicitud del Ministerio Público, un juez deberá determinar, en una audiencia de imposición de medidas, si acepta el pedido de los fiscales. Según el acta de imputación, el exmandatario está acusado por presunta lesión de confianza como instigador y por administración en provecho propio en calidad de autor. El documento indica que el expresidente “habría intervenido en circunstancias relacionadas con la colocación, renovación y permanencia de importantes sumas de dinero provenientes de entidades públicas y previsionales” en Ueno bank, una entidad con cuyo grupo empresarial Peña “habría mantenido una relación económica y corporativa previa”. Peña era accionista de Ueno Holding, un conglomerado del Grupo Vásquez que poseía, entre otras empresas, a Ueno bank. En marzo de 2025 vendió esa participación, detalló la acusación de los diputados que promovieron el juicio político en su contra. Ueno bank, añade el documento de la Fiscalía, habría recibido esos recursos públicos “mientras desarrollaba operaciones crediticias con sociedades presuntamente vinculadas a su grupo económico”, en las que “fueron identificadas observaciones e irregularidades por parte de los órganos de supervisión del Banco Central”. El Ministerio Público también imputó y pidió la prisión preventiva contra el expresidente del Banco Central de Paraguay (BCP) Carlos Carvallo, por presunta lesión de confianza, producción inmediata de documentos públicos de contenido falso y administración en provecho propio, en calidad de autor. Carvallo se presentó en la noche del viernes ante las autoridades y fue arrestado. El exfuncionario presidió la Financiera Ueno, de la que nació Ueno bank, antes de asumir en 2023 la jefatura de la entidad emisora, cuyo directorio autorizó “83 días después” de su designación la creación de la finiquitada entidad bancaria, explicaron los diputados en su acusación. Durante la administración de Peña, el Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS), una de las principales cajas pensionales del país, invirtió unos 355 millones de dólares en Ueno, que también administraba las cuentas de unos 32.000 jubilados. Por este caso, la Fiscalía también ha imputado a 27 personas, entre ellas Miguel Vásquez, uno de los fundadores de Ueno bank, quien este viernes fue trasladado junto a otros cinco directivos a cárceles para procesados.

articles.title: ¿Noviembre tiene feriados? Revisa los días libres de labores este 2026 en el Perú
articles.summary: Tras el feriado del primero de noviembre, te invitamos a conocer si hay otros feriados o días no laborables en el mes de noviembre. Conócelo todos en la siguiente nota.
articles.body_text: Los días libres son una oportunidad para compartir tiempo en familia, organizar actividades personales o realizar pequeños viajes sin las obligaciones habituales del trabajo. En noviembre de 2026, el calendario peruano contempla fechas de descanso que deben distinguirse entre feriados nacionales y días no laborables establecidos de manera extraordinaria. Estas últimas disposiciones están vinculadas con la visita del papa León XIV al Perú y comprenden jornadas y horarios específicos en Lima, Callao y otras regiones del país. Además, no todos los trabajadores tendrán las mismas condiciones para acceder a estos descansos, pues algunas medidas requieren compensar posteriormente las horas que se dejen de trabajar. Conoce qué fechas están previstas para noviembre, en qué lugares se aplicarán y cuáles son las diferencias que debes tener en cuenta antes de organizar tus actividades. El calendario de noviembre tiene un feriado nacional, el pasado 1 de noviembre, día de todos los santos, sin embargo; también cuenta con días NO laborables según lo indica la ley. Estas últimas fueron oficializadas mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 020-2026-TR, publicado en el diario oficial El Peruano. El calendario contempla las siguientes fechas: La compensación dependerá del sector laboral. En las entidades públicas, las horas pendientes deberán recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores al descanso o cuando lo determine el titular de cada institución, de acuerdo con las necesidades del servicio. En las empresas privadas, empleadores y trabajadores podrán acordar cómo reponer el tiempo no trabajado. Si no consiguen llegar a un consenso, el empleador establecerá las condiciones para realizar la compensación correspondiente. Aunque ambas fechas permiten interrumpir las actividades habituales, tienen condiciones distintas. El feriado constituye un descanso obligatorio reconocido por ley y no requiere recuperar las horas que correspondían a esa jornada. En cambio, los días no laborables suelen estar dirigidos principalmente al sector público y contemplan la recuperación posterior del tiempo pendiente. Para los trabajadores privados, su aplicación depende del acuerdo entre empleadores y trabajadores. Según la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), si un empleado trabaja en un día feriado debido a necesidades de la empresa o rotación de turnos, y no recibe un día libre en sustitución, debe recibir una compensación económica equivalente a tres veces su salario habitual por esa jornada laboral. Esto se debe a tres conceptos: No cumplir con el pago adicional o negar la compensación de descanso constituye una infracción muy grave en materia laboral. Las sanciones económicas varían según el tipo de empresa, y pueden ir desde poco más de 1.000 soles hasta superar los 24.000.

articles.title: El dólar cierra en S/3,42 y sol peruano lidera ganancias frente a monedas de la región
articles.summary: El precio del dólar cerró este viernes en S/3,426 en el mercado interbancario peruano, por debajo de los S/3,445 de la jornada anterior, con una caída de 0,55%.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este viernes en S/3,426 en el mercado interbancario peruano, por debajo de los S/3,445 de la jornada anterior, con una caída de 0,55%. El sol destacó como la moneda de mayor apreciación en América Latina durante la sesión, pese al fortalecimiento del dólar a nivel internacional, impulsado por los sólidos resultados del mercado laboral estadounidense. “El Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) avanzó 0,66%, hasta los 102.236 puntos, luego de conocerse un reporte de empleo en Estados Unidos que superó las expectativas del mercado. Este resultado fortaleció las perspectivas de un nuevo incremento de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal en diciembre, favoreciendo a la divisa estadounidense frente a sus principales pares”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el petróleo WTI retrocedió 0,83%, hasta US$89,77 por barril, mientras el oro cayó 0,58%. En contraste, el cobre avanzó 0,49% y la plata subió 0,25%. Las bolsas estadounidenses también registraron una recuperación, con un incremento de 1,34% del Nasdaq 100 y de 0,43% del S&P 500. En América Latina, el peso mexicano se apreció 0,67% y el real brasileño 0,11%, mientras el peso colombiano retrocedió 0,21%. En el mercado local, el tipo de cambio fluctuó entre S/3,421 y S/3,447, con un volumen negociado de US$510.8 millones. La apreciación del sol se produjo en una jornada de comportamiento mixto para las monedas latinoamericanas. En paralelo, la atención de los inversionistas se concentra en la próxima decisión de política monetaria del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), prevista para el jueves 12 de noviembre, luego de que la inflación interanual alcanzara 5,25% en octubre, frente al 4,55% de septiembre. De cara a la próxima semana, el análisis de Kambista señala que la decisión de tasas del BCR será uno de los principales factores para el comportamiento del dólar en Perú. Asimismo, los riesgos asociados al Fenómeno El Niño Costero seguirán siendo relevantes para las perspectivas económicas, luego de que el ENFEN advirtiera sobre la posibilidad de lluvias superiores a lo normal entre noviembre y enero, con potenciales efectos sobre la agricultura, la pesca y la infraestructura del país. Jesús Flores Ríos, gerente comercial de intermediación de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que el mercado laboral de EE.UU. mostró una fortaleza mayor a la esperada en octubre, con la creación de 165 mil empleos, frente a los 65 mil previstos, y una caída del desempleo a 4,1%. En conjunto, estos resultados sugieren un mercado laboral resistente, lo que podría reforzar la cautela de la Fed para reducir las tasas, ante posibles presiones inflacionarias. y el índice DXY cotizó en 102.31 (+0,74%).

articles.body_text: Como parte de su segundo día de actividades en Uruguay, el papa León XIV acudió al Parque París Londres para brindar la primera misa del sábado; sin embargo, lo que se robó las miradas de los fieles fue ver al Santo Padre cargar a tres bebés a lo largo de su recorrido. Así lo contó Juan Pablo León, enviado especial de El Comercio, quien captó en imágenes el instante en que seguidores católicos aproximaban a los menores, con ayuda del personal de seguridad, hacia el vehículo que transportaba al Sumo Pontífice. Cada uno de los niños recibió la bendición del Papa, quien respondió al gesto siempre con una sonrisa y mucho cuidado. Al concluir el recorrido, León XIV se encontró en el Parque París Londres, una explanada en la localidad de Paysandú situada en la frontera con Argentina y próxima a Brasil, donde peregrinos de países limítrofes acudieron a la primera misa de la jornada. El papa León XIV empleó un elemento uruguayo para destacar el vínculo necesario entre la humanidad: el mate. “El mate es signo de familiaridad, de amistad y de encuentro. Nos enseña a compartir y a estar juntos, a estrechar los lazos que nos unen y hermanan”, señaló el Santo Padre. “Seguramente el mate los ha acompañado también hoy, en el viaje de camino a esta celebración, y los acompañará al regresar”, dijo el Papa a los fieles, sobre esta costumbre que representa también “la acogida, la integración y los valores comunes”. “En esos espacios de soledad, cuántas veces tantos de ustedes le habrán confiado a Dios sus preocupaciones y necesidades, sus deseos y anhelos más profundos”, agregó. articles.title: ¿Noviembre tiene feriados? Revisa los días libres de labores este 2026 en el Perú
articles.summary: Tras el feriado del primero de noviembre, te invitamos a conocer si hay otros feriados o días no laborables en el mes de noviembre. Conócelo todos en la siguiente nota.
articles.body_text: Los días libres son una oportunidad para compartir tiempo en familia, organizar actividades personales o realizar pequeños viajes sin las obligaciones habituales del trabajo. En noviembre de 2026, el calendario peruano contempla fechas de descanso que deben distinguirse entre feriados nacionales y días no laborables establecidos de manera extraordinaria. Estas últimas disposiciones están vinculadas con la visita del papa León XIV al Perú y comprenden jornadas y horarios específicos en Lima, Callao y otras regiones del país. Además, no todos los trabajadores tendrán las mismas condiciones para acceder a estos descansos, pues algunas medidas requieren compensar posteriormente las horas que se dejen de trabajar. Conoce qué fechas están previstas para noviembre, en qué lugares se aplicarán y cuáles son las diferencias que debes tener en cuenta antes de organizar tus actividades. El calendario de noviembre tiene un feriado nacional, el pasado 1 de noviembre, día de todos los santos, sin embargo; también cuenta con días NO laborables según lo indica la ley. Estas últimas fueron oficializadas mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 020-2026-TR, publicado en el diario oficial El Peruano. El calendario contempla las siguientes fechas: La compensación dependerá del sector laboral. En las entidades públicas, las horas pendientes deberán recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores al descanso o cuando lo determine el titular de cada institución, de acuerdo con las necesidades del servicio. En las empresas privadas, empleadores y trabajadores podrán acordar cómo reponer el tiempo no trabajado. Si no consiguen llegar a un consenso, el empleador establecerá las condiciones para realizar la compensación correspondiente. Aunque ambas fechas permiten interrumpir las actividades habituales, tienen condiciones distintas. El feriado constituye un descanso obligatorio reconocido por ley y no requiere recuperar las horas que correspondían a esa jornada. En cambio, los días no laborables suelen estar dirigidos principalmente al sector público y contemplan la recuperación posterior del tiempo pendiente. Para los trabajadores privados, su aplicación depende del acuerdo entre empleadores y trabajadores. Según la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), si un empleado trabaja en un día feriado debido a necesidades de la empresa o rotación de turnos, y no recibe un día libre en sustitución, debe recibir una compensación económica equivalente a tres veces su salario habitual por esa jornada laboral. Esto se debe a tres conceptos: No cumplir con el pago adicional o negar la compensación de descanso constituye una infracción muy grave en materia laboral. Las sanciones económicas varían según el tipo de empresa, y pueden ir desde poco más de 1.000 soles hasta superar los 24.000.

articles.title: ¿Noviembre tiene feriados? Revisa los días libres de labores este 2026 en el Perú
articles.summary: Tras el feriado del primero de noviembre, te invitamos a conocer si hay otros feriados o días no laborables en el mes de noviembre. Conócelo todos en la siguiente nota.
articles.body_text: Los días libres son una oportunidad para compartir tiempo en familia, organizar actividades personales o realizar pequeños viajes sin las obligaciones habituales del trabajo. En noviembre de 2026, el calendario peruano contempla fechas de descanso que deben distinguirse entre feriados nacionales y días no laborables establecidos de manera extraordinaria. Estas últimas disposiciones están vinculadas con la visita del papa León XIV al Perú y comprenden jornadas y horarios específicos en Lima, Callao y otras regiones del país. Además, no todos los trabajadores tendrán las mismas condiciones para acceder a estos descansos, pues algunas medidas requieren compensar posteriormente las horas que se dejen de trabajar. Conoce qué fechas están previstas para noviembre, en qué lugares se aplicarán y cuáles son las diferencias que debes tener en cuenta antes de organizar tus actividades. El calendario de noviembre tiene un feriado nacional, el pasado 1 de noviembre, día de todos los santos, sin embargo; también cuenta con días NO laborables según lo indica la ley. Estas últimas fueron oficializadas mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 020-2026-TR, publicado en el diario oficial El Peruano. El calendario contempla las siguientes fechas: La compensación dependerá del sector laboral. En las entidades públicas, las horas pendientes deberán recuperarse dentro de los diez días posteriores al descanso o cuando lo determine el titular de cada institución, de acuerdo con las necesidades del servicio. En las empresas privadas, empleadores y trabajadores podrán acordar cómo reponer el tiempo no trabajado. Si no consiguen llegar a un consenso, el empleador establecerá las condiciones para realizar la compensación correspondiente. Aunque ambas fechas permiten interrumpir las actividades habituales, tienen condiciones distintas. El feriado constituye un descanso obligatorio reconocido por ley y no requiere recuperar las horas que correspondían a esa jornada. En cambio, los días no laborables suelen estar dirigidos principalmente al sector público y contemplan la recuperación posterior del tiempo pendiente. Para los trabajadores privados, su aplicación depende del acuerdo entre empleadores y trabajadores. Según la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), si un empleado trabaja en un día feriado debido a necesidades de la empresa o rotación de turnos, y no recibe un día libre en sustitución, debe recibir una compensación económica equivalente a tres veces su salario habitual por esa jornada laboral. Esto se debe a tres conceptos: No cumplir con el pago adicional o negar la compensación de descanso constituye una infracción muy grave en materia laboral. Las sanciones económicas varían según el tipo de empresa, y pueden ir desde poco más de 1.000 soles hasta superar los 24.000.

articles.title: Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call. | TechCrunch
articles.summary: As parents look for alternatives to unrestricted smartphones, a growing number of companies are building phones designed specifically for kids, from feature-limited mobile devices to minimalist home phones.
articles.body_text: As parents become increasingly concerned about the potential dangers of unrestricted smartphone access for children, a growing number of companies are developing devices specifically designed for kids. Today’s kid-friendly phones typically feature touchscreens, cameras, and communication capabilities similar to regular smartphones. However, the software on these devices is heavily modified to remove or restrict access to web browsers, social media, app stores, and other distractions. Parents can usually manage these devices through a companion app, allowing them to approve contacts, monitor locations, set screen time limits, select available apps, and, in some cases, receive alerts regarding cyberbullying, explicit content, or online predators. In addition to these modified devices, some companies offer a more minimalist approach, creating devices that focus solely on calling and texting. There are also home phones designed specifically for children, like Tin Can and the recently launched Pinwheel Home. Here’s a look at the major players shaping the kid-phone market. The Bark Phone is probably one of the most popular kid-specific smartphones on the market. Built on Samsung Galaxy hardware and powered by Bark’s monitoring software, it only allows calls and texts with approved contacts. Bark continuously scans texts, emails, photos, and supported apps for signs of cyberbullying, grooming, suicidal ideation, sexual content, and other potential concerns, then sends alerts to parents. A big standout feature is that parents can gradually unlock web browsing, apps, and other features as their child matures. The phone also includes GPS tracking and screen-time management. Current pricing for the standard model is $240 , plus a required wireless plan beginning at $29/month. Higher-tier plans add internet access and unlimited texting. Gabb is a well-known name in the kid-friendly phone category. Unlike Bark, however, Gabb focuses less on monitoring content and more on eliminating online risks altogether. Its phones don’t include social media, a browser, or an app store. Instead, children get calling, texting, and a carefully curated selection of preloaded apps, including a camera, calendar, and calculator. The company also touts its “worry-free” music streaming library with millions of songs.

articles.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
articles.body_text: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, a move that includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program. Observers warn that it would be a mistake to read too much into the London closure, since the British capital has a thriving AI scene. On the other hand, the decision to end scouts says more about where venture investing is headed. That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model, in which select founders and operators write checks on the firm’s behalf. Amid increased competition for deal flow, many VC firms followed suit . But a consensus now seems to be emerging that the model has reached its limits in its current form. Not everyone was sold on the model in the first place. “They pioneered the scout program but [to be honest] it never made sense to me!” VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week. “The scouts themselves don’t really care that much about the investments, you can still miss (like they did with Uber), not sure what it gets you. I suspect other firms will shutter theirs too,” he added. To be clear, Sequoia didn’t make a case against scouts in the memo. Instead, it framed its decision as part of a broader need for more focus. But its goal of “putting more energy behind fewer people and things” is likely to resonate with others who’ve questioned the ‘spray and pray’ approach to scouting. Rival firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), for instance, rolled out a global scout network aimed at spotting opportunities in the U.S. and also in smaller European hubs. But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.” Under this new approach, Vasquez explained, scouts get more resources but are also expected to be more active, such as by co-hosting dinners with the firm. “They get more budget, but we have reduced the number,” he said. This also seems to indicate that it is VC firms that have been driving an overhaul of the model. For founders, being a scout is attractive: it brings them closer to firms they may want checks from someday, or even a partner role with, and being seen as someone who can write a check can raise their standing among other founders. Some scouts will undoubtedly mourn the end of Sequoia’s program. Among them is Station F boss Roxanne Varza, who wrote on LinkedIn that she was “sad” to hear that the program was getting cut off, and “hope[d] that other funds [w]on’t follow suit.” Varza, a former Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025, told TechCrunch that she had no information beyond what has been shared publicly, but observed that becoming a scout had often been a stepping stone for aspiring investment managers. “I cannot name all of the incredible scouts that have gone on to join or build funds, but there are quite a few. And the scout programs may have helped them get there — allowed them to build an investment track record, allowed them to build relationships with various funds directly, and more,” she wrote to TechCrunch. According to Varza, the program’s impact went beyond the individual level, instead helping the entire ecosystem become more mature. “I believe they have helped to foster the investment culture and early-stage investment landscape that we now see in Europe, for example,” Varza said. While others may agree with Varza about the role these programs have played, they may still have run their course for two reasons. First, seasoned operators may get more financial upside as angels. When it’s their own money, they get to keep the returns, too. Second, leading VC firms are now big and well-known enough that the best founders tend to come to them, so they worry less about missing deals, except at the very earliest stages or in niches and geographies where they have less reach.

articles.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech | TechCrunch
articles.summary: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.
articles.body_text: Right before the midterm elections, OpenAI hired Jessica Schumer , daughter of Democratic Sen. Chuck Schumer. The company also said it would start calling its data centers “ compute campuses .” For the past two years, many of Silicon Valley’s biggest names have built closer ties with President Donald Trump and his administration. Several attended White House events, some companies scaled back diversity, equity and inclusion programs, and some executives donated millions to super PACs supporting his campaign and allied candidates. Administration policies also benefited the industry, including tax breaks, the pausing of some federal investigations, and looser AI regulation. Meanwhile, Meta faced lawsuits and billion-dollar fines, and OpenAI faced suits alleging its technology harmed users. Now, with the midterms shifting the balance of power in Washington, those same companies are working to rebuild ties with Democrats, who have pledged to tighten oversight of AI. How far that gets them may depend less on image-polishing than on where the real fights are happening: in state capitols, in communities deciding whether to host data centers, and, as we’ve seen this past week, in the markets watching the AI boom. J.B. Branch, director of federal AI governance and technology policy at Public Citizen, a nonprofit advocacy group that describes itself as nonpartisan, told me that the tech industry “realizes they have an optics problem.” He characterized moves like the Schumer hire and the rebranding as “PR washing.” He expects more of it, too, pointing to OpenAI’s partnership with the American Federation of Teachers, announced last year, as well as Anthropic’s newly launched Claude Corps and Meta’s America’s Workforce Academy. “I would imagine more of that sort of investment in these corporate, private-public partnerships,” he said. These initiatives didn’t spring up overnight. Meta and other tech companies reportedly began looking for ways to strengthen their ties to Democrats as Democratic gains in the midterms looked more likely. Reached for comment about the midterm elections’ impact on Meta, a company spokesperson pointed TechCrunch to remarks that Meta President Dina Powell McCormick made this week at WSJ Tech. “You have to work with the government that the American people elect,” McCormick had said. “I have seen it across the board that you have to be bipartisan, and you want to be, because you want buy-in on the things that you’re trying to do.” Not everyone expects them to work. Alice Marwick, director of research at the tech policy nonprofit Data & Society, told me she expects Big Tech to try to pivot back toward the middle, “if not the left. But it’s a little too late,” she said. “Tech companies should be asking themselves how their products can make people’s lives better, because right now, it doesn’t seem like they are.” If Democrats follow through on pledges to tighten oversight of AI and Big Tech, the industry could face a tougher environment. Data center moratoriums are gaining traction, and a wave of AI regulation bills awaits drafting. At the same event, Powell McCormick said Meta wants to show that communities welcoming its investments will see “an enormous amount of benefit,” while those that don’t want them “will of course have the right to stop them.” Still, the next two years could bring political gridlock in Washington. Aryan Ranjan, founder of Baraza, a political campaign management software company, told me most action will likely happen at the state level, since states have already sued tech companies and passed regulations. “A coalition built on newer, working-class voters is likely to push Democrats to frame AI around electricity bills, data-center siting and jobs rather than abstract AI safety,” he said of what to expect at the federal level. Last December, the Trump administration signed an executive order creating the AI Litigation Task Force , a federal group meant to challenge state AI laws. The administration has argued that U.S. AI companies “must be free to innovate without cumbersome regulations.” Many states have nonetheless passed their own laws, including measures on chatbots and deepfakes. It also remains to be seen how President Trump will respond, including whether he’ll sign more AI executive orders or veto bills that could be seen as anti-AI. Clearly, voters want stronger guardrails around the technology. In a statement to TechCrunch, a White House official said: “American leadership in super intelligence is essential for our national security, economic prosperity, and the quality of life of the American people. President Trump is committed to ensuring America continues to lead the world in super intelligence while protecting American consumers. As the President has said, he’s willing to work with anyone to continue delivering victories for hardworking Americans.” Branch argued that Trump’s political fortunes are now tied to the AI industry. On Wednesday, the day after the midterms, a trillion-dollar market sell-off spooked investors, some are whom are reportedly now reconsidering Anthropic’s reported trillion-dollar IPO. “There’s a very strong likelihood that there will be an AI bubble pop, and it’ll happen on Trump’s hands,” Branch said, predicting a possible market collapse. “Does he want to sink or swim along with the AI industry?”

articles.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.
articles.body_text: Crusoe, an eight-year-old, Denver-based data center developer recently valued at $30.9 billion , confirmed Friday it has sold an unfinished data center project in southeastern Wyoming to Google. Google, which Crusoe had tried and failed to land as a customer for the project, is taking over the development after reportedly raising concerns about its cost and construction timeline under Crusoe’s management. Crusoe initially announced the project last year with Blackstone-backed infrastructure company Tallgrass, planning to eventually scale it to 10 gigawatts of power capacity. Google did not disclose how much it paid Crusoe for the unfinished project, but it announced plans to invest $17 billion to develop the data center campus. The deal highlights how difficult it can be for independent data center developers to deliver massive projects on time and within budget, given the challenges of securing equipment and power. Growing opposition from local communities can further complicate development. Despite taking over the Wyoming facility, Google hasn’t walked away from working with Crusoe entirely. Crusoe is developing another data center for Google near Amarillo, Texas. The deal to sell the site to Google was first reported by Bloomberg in June, but the Wyoming setback didn’t stop Crusoe from raising a $3.9 billion round in September. Crusoe makes money by leasing data center space to customers that bring their own GPUs, by renting out its own GPUs, and by selling compute power used to run AI models, known as inference. Crusoe’s largest projects serve some of the biggest names in AI. Its campus in Abilene, Texas, is being built in phases for Oracle and OpenAI, and the company is also constructing a separate 900-megawatt campus next door for Microsoft, with its first building expected to come online in mid-2027. Meta is also a customer, and Bloomberg reported that the trading firm Jane Street signed a $13 billion , five-year cloud deal with Crusoe. Crusoe was founded by Chase Lochmiller, now its CEO, and Cully Cavness, who started it as a cryptocurrency-mining business powered by natural gas that would otherwise have been burned off. In September, alongside its $3.9 billion funding round, the company added three board members , including JB Straubel, the Redwood Materials founder and Tesla board member who invested in Crusoe in 2021. articles.title: The Duo apps are coming, says Apple | TechCrunch
articles.summary: There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple, and thousands more arrive daily.
articles.body_text: The early iPhone Duo reviews were a bit hard on Apple’s new foldable for the lack of Duo-optimized apps available at the time of launch. But Apple says things are changing quickly on the software front. The company on Friday announced there are now over 100,000 apps built for the Duo live on the App Store, and it’s seeing thousands more being added to the store every day. The news was timed alongside the release of over a dozen more notable Duo-ready apps, including Microsoft Word and Outlook, Zoom, sports apps from the NBA and NHL, shopping apps like Etsy and LTK, productivity apps like Goodnotes and Extra, the Halide Mark III camera app, and others. These join the iPhone Duo-optimized apps that were already available, like Netflix, YouTube, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Non-optimized apps are definitely less than ideal, as they come with a black bar on the side of the screen, which takes up valuable space. Sometimes, they hide important functions under an overflow menu. Apple’s data seems to suggest that at least some iOS developers may have needed extra time to get their apps ready for its latest form factor. The company said that more than 2,000 app developers attended its over 50 in-person workshops that were hosted across 19 cities worldwide. Here, the developers could use the Duo and work on their apps with Apple’s support. The Duo has also proven to be more popular than perhaps Apple had planned for, given its high price point. (It starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model.) The device quickly sold out within hours of orders opening up, and now, Duo ship times have shifted into the next year. On its earnings call this week, Apple said it’s “hard to predict” when the Duo constraints leading to those delays will improve . “It’s been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we’re grateful for their creativity and innovation,” said Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, in a statement referring to the 100,000-app milestone. “The enthusiasm has been incredible, and we’re excited to see the pace of updates continue to accelerate as more and more apps optimize for iPhone Duo,” she added. Other notable apps that have been updated for iOS 27 and optimized for the iPhone Duo include the following: Spotify, CBS, Tubi, BBC iPlayer (U.K.), Yahoo Fantasy Sports, Sportsnet (Canada), Facebook Messenger, Google Chat, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Microsoft Copilot, Excel, PowerPoint, SAP Concur, monday.com, PDF Expert, Documents, iA Writer, Substack, The Washington Post, Yahoo News, FOX News, Kalshi, Yahoo Finance, Canva, Suno, Tinder, Google Translate, Strava, Alma, Withings, MyFitnessPal, Bevel, Transit, Citi Bike, ParkMobile, Viator, Tesla Robotaxi, Priceline, Kroger, Domino’s, Taco Bell, Untappd, The Weather Channel, FOX Weather, and RainViewer. Not all these updates have yet to fully roll out, we should note. Spotify, for instance, is still showing the black bar on the side, and the App Store doesn’t yet say an update is available on our review unit of the Duo. However, given that this list comes directly from Apple, we expect to see these updates soon. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission .
